programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 世界生命之道:鄺保亮牧師
programme.desc: 鄺保亮牧師,與父親鄺健雄牧師一同於新加坡帶領9千多人的教會,承傳父親熱心佈道的精神,繼續以激勵人心的資訊,挑戰我們成為為主擺上的門徒!

programme.title: 一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會
programme.desc: 由「愛基金」主辦、「創世電視」協辦的「一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會」,聯合不同教會的力量,加上演藝人的見證,將福音帶給香港市民。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 郭文池牧師 - 給都市人的福音
programme.desc: 人無遠慮必有近憂,都市忙碌的生活,城市人的孤單焦慮隨處可見。究竟都市人在那裡可以找到福音?醫治心靈的良藥在那裡?

programme.title: 何偉強牧師-廿一世紀的屬靈人
programme.desc: 迷惘、沒有方向、疲乏,面對社會上的各種難題和困境,我們應該怎樣做,才能成為合符上帝心意的人? 何偉強牧師將會一連十三集,透過哥林多前書,與你講述處世之道。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 鋼琴大師的生命樂章
programme.desc: 巴哈, 莫劄特, 貝多芬, 蕭邦 - 四位誇越時代的鋼琴大師,在他們的生命樂章裏面,上帝的音符不斷跳動,並且影響後世無數音樂家。國際知名鋼琴家Sandra Wright Shen,曾獲得多個國際鋼琴大賽的冠軍,她將會為我們分享四位鋼琴大師的信仰故事。

programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-不由你不信之從靈界迷惑到真相大白
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」。奉主的名 帶著權柄與邪靈爭戰。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 郭文池牧師 - 給都市人的福音
programme.desc: 人無遠慮必有近憂,都市忙碌的生活,城市人的孤單焦慮隨處可見。究竟都市人在那裡可以找到福音?醫治心靈的良藥在那裡?

programme.title: 何偉強牧師-廿一世紀的屬靈人
programme.desc: 迷惘、沒有方向、疲乏,面對社會上的各種難題和困境,我們應該怎樣做,才能成為合符上帝心意的人? 何偉強牧師將會一連十三集,透過哥林多前書,與你講述處世之道。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽

方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#179粵
programme.desc: 自從溢跟母親到美國後，義每晚都要人陪他與溢視象會議。義被公司勒令放假，到按摩椅專門店消磨時間，但竟讓他發現，花亦被勒令放假，令義驚覺二人皆沒有知心友。朋命義為家中進行維修，義向花求救，花義無反顧答應。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#24粵普
programme.desc: 郭靖和黃蓉在白鵰的幫助下離開鐵掌山，為躲避追捕，又走進了瘴氣林。在瑛姑的指引下，二人找到段皇爺替黃蓉療傷，段皇爺服下黃蓉所贈的九花玉露丸以便恢復元氣，卻不料中毒；得知下毒的是瑛姑，便提及二人昔日恩怨…

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 退休Chill級歎世界粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 今集造訪凍肉海產公司搜購超平凍肉，不用五元就買到一大隻鴨髀，炮製「鴨腿湯飯」至抵吃。「牛油、青口、天使麵」這個組合落入肥媽手上，24元就煮得好美味。還有肥媽推介、味道豐富的「醬燒巴西豬仔骨配焗薯」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 長期鼻塞未必單純由感冒或鼻敏感引起，可能與鼻中隔彎曲有關？先天或後天因素都有機會引致此結構問題，耳鼻喉科醫生帶來治療資訊，還提醒長期依賴通鼻塞藥物，恐會陷入惡性循環。戲劇大師毛俊輝繼續細談在美國的演出經歷，開心獲業內知名導演賞識。回港發展後，他亦難忘抱病與黃霑、顧嘉煇攜手打造勵志音樂劇。此外，他感激太太胡美儀多年來不離不棄，也談及透過慈善基金，培育戲劇新一代。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「人參魚湯」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 嘉賓王敏奕自懂得談戀愛起迷上下廚，還視之為傳遞愛的好方法。她近來喜歡鑽研素食，帶來一道既簡單又惹味的「韓式燒素牛肉」。杏鮑菇可變奏出不同滋味，諾懿大花心思，為美女獻上「杏鮑菇玫瑰」。揀選扇貝有何要訣？黑松露、金銀蒜看似味道不搭，兩者一同加入扇貝蒸煮，卻換來意想不到的驚喜！敏奕自製卡邦尼汁，奉上「蘑菇貓耳貝殼粉」；她又建議善用煮意粉水，可以有多種用途。另外，敏之亦會一展刀功，將士多啤梨變成美艷花朵。

programme.title: 天梯#10粵
programme.desc: 濟民要代苗天還債，更指賀正堂已無可救藥，無必要害苗天。濟民使計避開苗天，不讓他有請辭的機會。苗天未開口請辭，濟民已對苗天破口大罵，更打了他一拳，苗天承諾只幫賀正堂一年，最後濟民高聲嚷出要解僱苗天。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 聽到同學們說起善解人意的爸爸，再回家目睹自己爸爸宏志醉醺醺的樣子，令小丸子產生了比較心理，對爸爸滿肚牢騷。小丸子更嘗試透過改變稱謂，希望讓宏志變成理想中的好爸爸，但宏志卻依然故我……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 非撞式欖球的主要特點在於禁止猛烈衝撞與擒抱，防守方只需以手輕觸進攻球員，對方就必須停下。非撞式欖球學校兩位代表到來「Kids’ Notes」，介紹這項運動的規則與玩法。由於非撞式欖球的身體接觸較少，適合男女一同參與；同來的女學員亦分享非撞式欖球的獨特吸引力。兩位代表淺談非撞式欖球的發展前景，更指出小朋友如參與這運動，不僅可鍛練體能，也能培養良好的堅毅精神與紀律。本集還有AI生成動畫《塞翁失馬》。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄用「重量燈」改變事物重量，先替媽媽解決體重煩惱，其後加重自己，成功把胖虎撞飛。大雄想借「傳染癦痣」轉移性格避過胖虎責罰，誰知在陰差陽錯下，令胖虎變得像野貓一般獸性大發。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 退休Chill級歎世界粵
programme.desc: 位處北都的洪水橋，樓價一直相對低水，政府早前於區內以片區形式賣地，能否刺激樓價？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵

東張西望粵 及 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 有觀眾報料遇到上集報道的「轉數快騙徒」，並即時報警，籲公眾提防受騙。韓國男子與妻育有一對子女，他偶然從妻子手機發現一些曖昧對話，更驚悉自己所撫養的女兒非親生！他責怪妻子發展婚外情之際，反遭恐嚇，稱會對其兒子不利……林盛斌與「女神」們同看節目第二季首播，眾人笑談各求愛勇者表現。郭富城出席馬場活動，分享全家趁暑假同遊新加坡的深刻點滴。粵車南下已實施，惟內地與香港道路規則存在差異，這集帶來實用駕駛貼士。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#21粵
programme.desc: 萬里需找舞伴出席為客人籌辦的慈善舞會，原屬意與文謙同行，卻遭他婉拒，遂考慮找安多勳作伴。朱圓圓卻大潑冷水，認為二人並不合襯，難有長遠發展。她更遞上一張卡片，提出可讓安多勳「彌補不足」的建議。面對舞伴人選，萬里始終猶豫不決。此時，安多勳一個奇異舉動，竟勾起萬里一段痛苦往事，並引發連串風波……安多勳意外得知萬里打算邀請他出席舞會，更偶然發現那張卡片，明白萬里的顧慮，遂決意成為「襯得起」她的舞伴……

programme.title: 死有對証#1粵PG
programme.desc: 清晨時分，流浪漢於垃圾站內發現疑似人肉屍塊。新任女法醫程芷昕第一天上班就奉命到場，搜索其餘的人體組織。芷昕自小患有強迫症，為人心直口快，在搜索過程中與重案組警員高俊結下不解之緣。芷昕想參與檢驗骸骨，卻被上司林琛投閒置散。法醫方文琪請客歡迎芷昕加入殮房團隊，從芷昕推薦的「佳權飯店」叫來外賣；林琛竟發現與案件有關的線索。同時，高俊也着手調查，線索皆指向佳權……芷昕閨密單佩嘉因吃過佳權的飯菜，大感不安。

programme.title: 百花殺#3粵普PG
programme.desc: 各皇子為取得西北軍權而想娶汐和，華雍便出手打擊。汐和得悉《胭脂錄》的幕後主使是康王，便誘使康王府的羅側妃頂證他。康王被捉拿後，對華雍透露當日餵他吃酪櫻桃的人就是下毒之人，而此人正是父皇，華雍不願相信…

programme.title: 玄戰粵PG
programme.desc: 「山風GPS」阿嵐、「幻月婆婆」、「定海神John」、「熊孩兒」Baebae，加上憑藉預測「金多寶」回歸的「黑貓之眼」BlackCat，合共五位黑先知解鎖新一輪戰局！五名白先知則強勢降臨，「北宋丞相第33代傳人」Jim Sir、「獨角獸天使」Angel、「高感招財貓」阿元、「AI女神」Aster、「孔子第77代傳人」KK孔，會各自揀選一位黑先知作對決。黑先知亦可物色助力拍檔，黑白大戰一觸即發！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 退休Chill級歎世界粵
澳娛綜合呈獻：十月初五的月光#1粵PG
programme.desc: 歌女朱莎嬌年青時裙下之臣無數，卻不為所動。嬌妹莎華為人記仇，嫁得賭業鉅子萬世光，對舊情敵文貴芳仍懷恨在心。貴芳遭拋棄，莎華心涼。貴芳欲攜子文初尋死，不果，一走了之，遺下因受驚過度變成啞巴的文初由莎嬌撫養。莎嬌及後邂逅大學生祝展輝，為他誕下一女君好。展輝赴英升學，遺下母女。記者司徒禮信籌備澳門專輯，到賭場偷拍卻與君好發生誤會。文初得悉賭場中人對禮信不利，莎嬌、君好與禮信在一起，立即趕至救回眾人。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 有觀眾報料遇到上集報道的「轉數快騙徒」，並即時報警，籲公眾提防受騙。韓國男子與妻育有一對子女，他偶然從妻子手機發現一些曖昧對話，更驚悉自己所撫養的女兒非親生！他責怪妻子發展婚外情之際，反遭恐嚇，稱會對其兒子不利……林盛斌與「女神」們同看節目第二季首播，眾人笑談各求愛勇者表現。郭富城出席馬場活動，分享全家趁暑假同遊新加坡的深刻點滴。粵車南下已實施，惟內地與香港道路規則存在差異，這集帶來實用駕駛貼士。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 長期鼻塞未必單純由感冒或鼻敏感引起，可能與鼻中隔彎曲有關？先天或後天因素都有機會引致此結構問題，耳鼻喉科醫生帶來治療資訊，還提醒長期依賴通鼻塞藥物，恐會陷入惡性循環。戲劇大師毛俊輝繼續細談在美國的演出經歷，開心獲業內知名導演賞識。回港發展後，他亦難忘抱病與黃霑、顧嘉煇攜手打造勵志音樂劇。此外，他感激太太胡美儀多年來不離不棄，也談及透過慈善基金，培育戲劇新一代。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「人參魚湯」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 嘉賓王敏奕自懂得談戀愛起迷上下廚，還視之為傳遞愛的好方法。她近來喜歡鑽研素食，帶來一道既簡單又惹味的「韓式燒素牛肉」。杏鮑菇可變奏出不同滋味，諾懿大花心思，為美女獻上「杏鮑菇玫瑰」。揀選扇貝有何要訣？黑松露、金銀蒜看似味道不搭，兩者一同加入扇貝蒸煮，卻換來意想不到的驚喜！敏奕自製卡邦尼汁，奉上「蘑菇貓耳貝殼粉」；她又建議善用煮意粉水，可以有多種用途。另外，敏之亦會一展刀功，將士多啤梨變成美艷花朵。

programme.title: 天梯#10粵
programme.desc: 濟民要代苗天還債，更指賀正堂已無可救藥，無必要害苗天。濟民使計避開苗天，不讓他有請辭的機會。苗天未開口請辭，濟民已對苗天破口大罵，更打了他一拳，苗天承諾只幫賀正堂一年，最後濟民高聲嚷出要解僱苗天。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#179粵
programme.desc: 自從溢跟母親到美國後，義每晚都要人陪他與溢視象會議。義被公司勒令放假，到按摩椅專門店消磨時間，但竟讓他發現，花亦被勒令放假，令義驚覺二人皆沒有知心友。朋命義為家中進行維修，義向花求救，花義無反顧答應。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#24粵普
programme.desc: 郭靖和黃蓉在白鵰的幫助下離開鐵掌山，為躲避追捕，又走進了瘴氣林。在瑛姑的指引下，二人找到段皇爺替黃蓉療傷，段皇爺服下黃蓉所贈的九花玉露丸以便恢復元氣，卻不料中毒；得知下毒的是瑛姑，便提及二人昔日恩怨…

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#180粵
programme.desc: 溢覺花的電腦需更換零件，便在花的鐵盒中取出兩張五百元紙幣。但這兩張紙幣是當日花從義身上搶來的，獲花視為至寶。義感冒，花對義呵顧備至，溢從花的電腦中，找到一封「寄不出的情信」，揭發花瘋狂地暗戀著義。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#25粵普PG
programme.desc: 瑛姑本想殺一燈，裘千仞來到，瑛姑認出他是殺她孩兒真兇，兩人交手，郭靖黃蓉出手相助。一燈大師翻譯《九陰真經》梵文總綱，表示依此修練，武功很快會復原。江南六怪想解除全真教對黃藥師的誤會，黃藥師卻避而不見。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽有云「識食一定係食細魚」，六號立即學習用梭羅魚煲湯。肥媽常教大家用電飯煲煮雞，「水晶雞」又有甚麼來頭？愈來愈少家庭會用慈菇做菜，肥媽決定示範利用南乳汁、五花腩加慈菇做菜；她又教煮「韓國泡菜煎餅」。

programme.title: 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 來自選秀節目《魔音女團》的莊子璇、喬美莎、倪樂琳、宋宛穎、倪嘉雯、盧映彤等「星級」藝員參演的微短劇。故事描述Hilary(莊子璇)為了追尋唱跳夢，參加「超級新星」選拔；某天，她於偶然下發現「魔幻百變床褥」的神奇效果，毅然有所決定……

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 運動有益，但部份重複動作，或會造成慢性的「運動創傷」。骨科醫生詳析肩部的運動創傷，如何分辨創傷與肌肉痠勞？除了主要採用的保守治療資訊，醫生亦細說急性肩部創傷的「PRICE」處理原則。李蕙敏的慘情歌觸動人心，相隔近十年再出歌，卻是一首思念離世父親的親情歌，緣何有這構思？身為時代女性，蕙敏唱而優則演，也曾開時裝店，不斷自我增值，她亦鼓勵觀眾在人生中多作嘗試。「睇餸食飯」，三姐示範「涼瓜子薑牛肉脆麵」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 白鱔是秋冬當造食材，諾懿先傳授簡單的去潺方法，並製作彈牙可口的「日式炭燒白鱔」。不需講究刀功，亦可將青葡萄、啤梨變成得意箭豬，留意敏之示範。嘉賓糖妹喜歡挑戰花功夫的菜式，她到來炮製「糖妹釀蟹蓋」，盡顯廚藝心思！下廚期間，她提到「鮑魚有眼」的說法，令主持們大感驚訝……原條牛柳肉質嫩滑，糖妹用多款香料與紅酒煮成醬汁，將牛柳燜煮至軟腍入味，諾懿從旁協助卻笑言被當作「鑊鏟」？諾懿另會奉上「火焰煙燻牛柳」。

programme.title: 天梯#11粵
programme.desc: 新月宣布新任大查櫃乃苗天，苗天告知全叔的記錄簿，新月為可重新聯絡客戶而高興。苗天建議鄭嬌回鄉拜祭妻子，鄭嬌往找愛娣卻沒有人應門；達嫂表示愛娣已幾天沒踏出家門，鄭嬌用木梯爬進愛娣屋內，發現愛娣躺在床上。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子看見百惠穿大紅色晚裝很漂亮，於是自己也打扮到全身紅色，更遇上同樣一身火紅的青年音樂人。藤木發現藍色能代表自己，更是很好的顏色，於是打扮到一身藍色，卻意外吸引到一名女生的目光。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: Tiffany姐姐一人引領薯片隊、曲奇隊小兵進入零食廠，與蚌蚌公主打招呼後，便隨即開展「廠長話」遊戲。某位女隊員稍一鬆懈就出現失誤，拍檔疑受影響亦跟着做錯指令，最終一起遭淘汰。運送雪糕球任務，四位小兵看來都非常大膽，雙方皆順利做出共廿個或以上的佳績，實力旗鼓相當！輪到堆疊漢堡包食材的比拼，兩隊於第一回合的表現不相伯仲。第二回合，薯片兵團縱有點亂了陣腳，卻可快速反省，並於最後一輪作出改善，值得一讚。

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 果Jam叔叔一行人，為了觀看演奏會而前往Do- Re-Mi-Fa島。在途中，細菌人因為討厭音樂而阻撓一行人前進。細菌人襲擊大碗飯三人組失敗了。之後碰巧發現濃湯嬸嬸正製作濃湯，便企圖偷吃。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 胃癌是起源於胃黏膜上皮的惡性腫瘤，初期症狀常與胃炎或胃潰瘍相似而不易察覺。除了做手術切除受影響的胃部，部分亦要接受吊針化療，而且要配合口服化療藥。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 富途證券特約:富途講美股粵 及 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#22粵
programme.desc: 戴志昌的公司推出新產品，萬里欲與楊帆爭奪此宣傳項目。志昌有意為產品物色靚聲代言人，偶然聽到嘉冰的歌聲後大為欣賞，更積極接近她。朱圓圓懷疑志昌另有企圖，萬里起初不以為然，其後卻漸覺不妥。嘉冰得知志昌是萬里的重要客戶後，不顧萬里勸阻，答應與他飯聚。楊帆質疑萬里為爭取項目而利用嘉冰，並指志昌過往與代言人飯聚後往往另有安排。萬里大感不安，急忙聯絡嘉冰，惟她已到埗，更表示會盡力協助萬里爭取這個項目……

programme.title: 死有對証#2粵PG
programme.desc: 高俊等重案組警員到「佳權飯店」展開調查，確認店內為案發現場，遇害者正是老闆娘。老闆娘的姪女阮碧鳳、姪兒阮濤在佳權工作，同稱對姑丈、姑母失蹤不知情。港聞記者詹柏宇窮追不捨地追訪阮氏姊弟，芷昕撞見後上前解圍，並邀請二人到家中作客。芷昕察覺碧鳳手上有紅疹，欲關心她，兩姊弟卻匆匆離開。重案組接獲線報，在廢屋中發現佳權老闆的遺體及老闆娘原先下落不明的頭顱，老闆疑似畏罪輕生。林琛解剖屍體後，有重大發現……

programme.title: 百花殺#4粵普PG
programme.desc: 華雍特意引汐和看花燈，汐和看穿疏林是女子，教她跟晉百做朋友令其他女子不敢靠近；有朝臣女兒侮辱西北，瀠繞想害汐和落水，汐和反擊…華雍邀汐和觀賞蔓星苔發現彼此投契，長贏帶安西防禦圖殘角拜訪汐和，汐和拒見…

programme.title: 玄戰粵PG
programme.desc: 自古以來，參透未來、扭轉乾坤的玄妙之術總是令人神往。然而，在流派百家爭鳴的當前，真正洞悉天機的能人，到底身在何方？注入直播元素的新節目《玄戰》，會掀開不一樣的戰幕。節目組廣邀潛藏民間的玄學高手化身「黑先知」，眾人務必通過重重嚴苛關卡，爭奪晉級資格。海選中表現最好五人獲賦以「白先知」身分，並與突圍而出的黑先知開展對壘。這是一場賭上名譽與實力的玄學之戰，究竟誰人可破譯天機、洞悉玄奧，成為「一代先知」？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵

澳娛綜合呈獻：十月初五的月光#2粵PG
programme.desc: 文初為救眾人受傷送院，禮信內疚。文初好友金勝到賭場找晦氣，被世光、莎華所逐。世光長子沛堅與君好好友汪海琳相戀，因門戶不登對不為莎華所接受。金勝雖風流，獨荷官江依文對他死心塌地。世光自知其手下令文初受傷，著莎華找莎嬌擺平。莎華心知莎嬌不會接受自己的金錢，簽下香油祈求莎嬌一家平安作補償。沛堅為報答文初不供出誰放炸彈，介紹文初到芬蘭浴室工作。莎嬌無意中知道文初到浴室工作，震怒不已。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 運動有益，但部份重複動作，或會造成慢性的「運動創傷」。骨科醫生詳析肩部的運動創傷，如何分辨創傷與肌肉痠勞？除了主要採用的保守治療資訊，醫生亦細說急性肩部創傷的「PRICE」處理原則。李蕙敏的慘情歌觸動人心，相隔近十年再出歌，卻是一首思念離世父親的親情歌，緣何有這構思？身為時代女性，蕙敏唱而優則演，也曾開時裝店，不斷自我增值，她亦鼓勵觀眾在人生中多作嘗試。「睇餸食飯」，三姐示範「涼瓜子薑牛肉脆麵」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 白鱔是秋冬當造食材，諾懿先傳授簡單的去潺方法，並製作彈牙可口的「日式炭燒白鱔」。不需講究刀功，亦可將青葡萄、啤梨變成得意箭豬，留意敏之示範。嘉賓糖妹喜歡挑戰花功夫的菜式，她到來炮製「糖妹釀蟹蓋」，盡顯廚藝心思！下廚期間，她提到「鮑魚有眼」的說法，令主持們大感驚訝……原條牛柳肉質嫩滑，糖妹用多款香料與紅酒煮成醬汁，將牛柳燜煮至軟腍入味，諾懿從旁協助卻笑言被當作「鑊鏟」？諾懿另會奉上「火焰煙燻牛柳」。

programme.title: 天梯#11粵
programme.desc: 新月宣布新任大查櫃乃苗天，苗天告知全叔的記錄簿，新月為可重新聯絡客戶而高興。苗天建議鄭嬌回鄉拜祭妻子，鄭嬌往找愛娣卻沒有人應門；達嫂表示愛娣已幾天沒踏出家門，鄭嬌用木梯爬進愛娣屋內，發現愛娣躺在床上。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#180粵
programme.desc: 溢覺花的電腦需更換零件，便在花的鐵盒中取出兩張五百元紙幣。但這兩張紙幣是當日花從義身上搶來的，獲花視為至寶。義感冒，花對義呵顧備至，溢從花的電腦中，找到一封「寄不出的情信」，揭發花瘋狂地暗戀著義。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#25粵普PG
programme.desc: 瑛姑本想殺一燈，裘千仞來到，瑛姑認出他是殺她孩兒真兇，兩人交手，郭靖黃蓉出手相助。一燈大師翻譯《九陰真經》梵文總綱，表示依此修練，武功很快會復原。江南六怪想解除全真教對黃藥師的誤會，黃藥師卻避而不見。

programme.title: 我是小廚神-新加坡篇粵普
programme.desc: 來到總決賽，主題是「自選菜單」，Tebo、Leonika要在三小時內製作頭盤、主菜和甜品，爭奪冠軍寶座。Leonika刻意加入廣東元素，以中藥材蒸紅斑魚帶出「家」的味道，令一眾香港主持及評判一解鄉愁！神奇小子Tebo煎三文魚恰到好處，全宇宙最「脆」的蘋果酥還成功俘虜人心！評判團張倩敏、楊國基、黃淑儀如何抉擇？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#181粵
programme.desc: 高家廟堂重開，鄉親邀請眾人剪綵兼祭祖，朋因此變得異常緊張，終日提心吊膽會發生意外，令大家亦變得神經緊張。悅的回鄉證經已過期，令出發日典延遲。但到了再出發時，一宗交通意外，令眾人明白有備無患的重要。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#26粵普PG
programme.desc: 江南五怪死在桃花島，柯鎮惡和郭靖認定是黃藥師所為，郭靖與黃蓉恩斷義絕，黃藥師赴全真六子的約戰，郭靖解開他們的誤會後要找黃藥師報仇，洪七公出面勸說，要郭靖查清事件，完顏洪烈率楊康、歐陽鋒等人來到醉仙樓…

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 退休Chill級歎世界粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽以西式煮法炮製草根美食「牛雜」，茄味香濃的「翡冷翠金錢肚」夾麵包進食味道超班；牛骨髓，肥媽同樣有辦法做成「入屋菜」，又極速示範「麻婆豆腐炒金錢腱」。接着用「皮菜」的鹹香，令豆腐海帶湯充滿海水鮮味。

programme.title: 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 來自選秀節目《魔音女團》的莊子璇、喬美莎、倪樂琳、宋宛穎、倪嘉雯、盧映彤等「星級」藝員參演的微短劇。故事描述Hilary(莊子璇)為了追尋唱跳夢，參加「超級新星」選拔；某天，她於偶然下發現「魔幻百變床褥」的神奇效果，毅然有所決定……

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 女性踏入更年期後，患心臟病風險將會增高？心臟科醫生指重點是缺乏女性賀爾蒙的保護，早停經女士的風險亦會較高。想從飲食降低心血管疾病風險，則要記得「三低一高零反式」原則，並適量做中強度運動。中醫學說提到，眼睛出問題與多個臟腑也可能有關。針對青光眼，醫師從中醫學角度解說成因，痰濕重、肥胖是高危一族？醫師亦提供一些常用治療青光眼的藥材、穴位針灸及湯水茶飲建議。「睇餸食飯」，許美德示範「胡椒長旺焗中蝦煲」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 陸浩明(六號)跟隨肥媽主持烹飪節目多年，他這次獨自登場一展廚藝，更揚言日後要肥媽當其助手？六號帶來「甜酸黑椒鹿兒島黑豚扒」，但略展刀功已教主持們擔憂不已……要去除羊架的羶味，有何妙法？諾懿用豉油醃羊架，有助提升香味；將焗羊架伴以雙色薯蓉上碟，賣相與味道兼備。六號則會炮製「蒜香煎羊架伴素菜」，同樣講求心機！鮑魚洗刷前，宜先略為蒸煮？諾懿傳授「香蒜牛油鮮鮑魚」的烹調技巧。敏之另會教大家包「金魚餃子」。

programme.title: 天梯#12粵
programme.desc: 達嫂無法給愛娣餵食中藥，麗荷提議找西醫治愛娣。客人飲用過永康堂用柴胡煲的藥後均嘔吐大作，苗天以身試藥，認為柴胡可能被加入巴豆粉。大批人圍著賀宅要求賠錢，新月問苗天有多少錢打官司，苗天卻謂她知道會失眠。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子去圖書館尋找自由研究的題材，卻在那裡遇見山田，對方打算研究妖怪，並建議兩人一起寫作業。暑假最後一個星期天，天氣酷熱，小丸子尚未完成暑期功課，卻出外跟朋友玩耍，更意外弄髒衣服。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 水是人體不可或缺的生命泉源，但大家對每天飲用的水究竟有多少了解？亮相「Kids’ Notes」的品水師指，水主要以曾否加工處理，分為淨化水與天然礦泉水，同時也會根據水中的礦物質含量區分為軟水與硬水。軟水因所含礦物質較少，味道會相對清甜。嘉賓除了引領主持姐姐體驗品水步驟，還會介紹品水課程的學習內容與認證考試。她更分享品水師的日常工作點滴，並提到使用軟水或硬水泡咖啡、炒菜，有機會產生不同的差異。

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 辣椒子妹妹喜歡辣的食物。因為聽聞咖哩包超人的咖哩很辣很美味，於是躍躍欲試。蒜頭大師要蒜頭小子，把蒜頭送去給酸梅婆婆。但性急的蒜頭小子，未有問清楚正確地點，便一支箭似的衝了出門。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 退休Chill級歎世界粵
programme.desc: 大圍新盤陸續入伙，有大單位玻璃崩花，浴室過牆喉沒封妥，連電掣面板也鬆脫，怎樣處理？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#23粵
programme.desc: 嘉驄為要滿足朱圓圓的種種要求，令「開心小棧」虧損累累，遂希望藉唐芯、楊光等人幫忙勸止圓圓，豈料眾人反被她說服，紛紛倒戈支持她。其後，圓圓將小棧改造成主題咖啡店，成功吸引大批客人，卻引起嘉驄極度不滿。嘉驄找萬里等人告狀，要求她們主持公道……圓圓經萬里規勸後有所收斂，嘉驄表明不會再為滿足她的需求而提供額外服務，本以為終可鬆一口氣，豈料因某些原因，仍要對圓圓有求必應……

programme.title: 死有對証#3粵PG
programme.desc: 芷昕遇襲，危急之際，高俊及時現身營救……法醫科顧問醫生潘炳焱看出芷昕對工作的熱誠，勸說林琛給予對方機會。佩嘉在街頭撞見男友出軌，一氣之下拿了客戶交予她的名牌高跟鞋教訓男友，此事在網絡上瘋傳。林琛仍不信任芷昕的能力，着她負責應對家屬的工作。有死者家屬拜託芷昕成全逝者的遺願，讓她穿上低胸晚禮服出殯，但是解剖會在死者胸口留下疤痕，芷昕陷入兩難，只好硬着頭皮請林琛幫忙……

programme.title: 百花殺#5粵普
programme.desc: 皇上下旨徹查防禦圖一事，長贏送還防禦圖，汐和對他改觀。汐和救下將士遺孤後探訪孤獨園，園內長贏拜託她徹查西北軍需糧餉情況。華雍設局舉證，令貪腐通敵的董必權被打入天牢，並試圖在獄中向其問出西域奇毒的線索。

programme.desc: 莎嬌接展輝來電找君好，展輝卻假裝不認得莎嬌。展輝之妻馬冰心素以擁有幸福家庭自詡。禮信與展輝及展輝兒子健康游泳，勾起兒時弟弟被溺斃情景，此事亦成為他與母親的隔膜。世光幼子沛祺知金勝購新車準備出賽，對他奚落一番。展輝約君好吃飯，君好乘機拉攏莎嬌與展輝見面。莎嬌明白展輝心意，約會當日藉故爽約，君好失望。冰心無意中看到君好與展輝親熱拍照，心下一沉。禮信到電視台當新聞報道員需要有懂手語人士配合，即想起文初。

programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 女性踏入更年期後，患心臟病風險將會增高？心臟科醫生指重點是缺乏女性賀爾蒙的保護，早停經女士的風險亦會較高。想從飲食降低心血管疾病風險，則要記得「三低一高零反式」原則，並適量做中強度運動。中醫學說提到，眼睛出問題與多個臟腑也可能有關。針對青光眼，醫師從中醫學角度解說成因，痰濕重、肥胖是高危一族？醫師亦提供一些常用治療青光眼的藥材、穴位針灸及湯水茶飲建議。「睇餸食飯」，許美德示範「胡椒長旺焗中蝦煲」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 陸浩明(六號)跟隨肥媽主持烹飪節目多年，他這次獨自登場一展廚藝，更揚言日後要肥媽當其助手？六號帶來「甜酸黑椒鹿兒島黑豚扒」，但略展刀功已教主持們擔憂不已……要去除羊架的羶味，有何妙法？諾懿用豉油醃羊架，有助提升香味；將焗羊架伴以雙色薯蓉上碟，賣相與味道兼備。六號則會炮製「蒜香煎羊架伴素菜」，同樣講求心機！鮑魚洗刷前，宜先略為蒸煮？諾懿傳授「香蒜牛油鮮鮑魚」的烹調技巧。敏之另會教大家包「金魚餃子」。

programme.title: 天梯#12粵
programme.desc: 達嫂無法給愛娣餵食中藥，麗荷提議找西醫治愛娣。客人飲用過永康堂用柴胡煲的藥後均嘔吐大作，苗天以身試藥，認為柴胡可能被加入巴豆粉。大批人圍著賀宅要求賠錢，新月問苗天有多少錢打官司，苗天卻謂她知道會失眠。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#181粵
programme.desc: 高家廟堂重開，鄉親邀請眾人剪綵兼祭祖，朋因此變得異常緊張，終日提心吊膽會發生意外，令大家亦變得神經緊張。悅的回鄉證經已過期，令出發日典延遲。但到了再出發時，一宗交通意外，令眾人明白有備無患的重要。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#26粵普PG
programme.desc: 江南五怪死在桃花島，柯鎮惡和郭靖認定是黃藥師所為，郭靖與黃蓉恩斷義絕，黃藥師赴全真六子的約戰，郭靖解開他們的誤會後要找黃藥師報仇，洪七公出面勸說，要郭靖查清事件，完顏洪烈率楊康、歐陽鋒等人來到醉仙樓…

programme.title: Sunday好戲王粵PG
programme.desc: 主持森美、陳敏之請來「星級」參賽者黃智賢、姚子羚、袁偉豪、楊詩敏「鬥戲」；嘉賓評判薛家燕則為各回合選出優勝者。子羚被安排和小龜合演對手戲，引來全場爆笑，究竟是怎麼一回事？

programme.title: 小小動物歷險記
programme.desc: 動物園可真是個瘋狂的地方！原本不在同一片大陸的動物，如今都在一起共同生活。但對一群好朋友來說，動物園就是他們的家！這裡有活潑好動的大象拉拉、聰明的鱷魚沃比、害羞的白虎咪噗、俏皮的水獺可可子，還有勇敢的鴿子狄爾，快來和我們一起認識這群朋友吧！

programme.title: 變異少年德克斯
programme.desc: 在賽博科技接受訓練的德克斯，意外得知關於「家人」的秘密後，與反叛者斯坎、佐拉結盟，並獲得能使用動物能力的變異手套，決定解放被賽博科技控制的民眾，展開屬於他們的戰鬥！

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.desc: 俄羅斯經典動畫系列新作！歡樂悠閒的羅莎渡假村，歡迎世界各地的旅客，在此度過最放鬆的假期！然而，調皮的狼總是想和兔子一爭高下，藉此吸引鹿小姐的注意！

programme.title: 往哪跑！
programme.desc: 俄羅斯經典動畫系列新作！歡樂悠閒的羅莎渡假村，歡迎世界各地的旅客，在此度過最放鬆的假期！然而，調皮的狼總是想和兔子一爭高下，藉此吸引鹿小姐的注意！

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌(完)
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Sabotaje
programme.desc: Chip es un niño de 9 años que prefiere jugar con sus compañeros antes de las clases de física y química con su maestra Susan. Un día, durante una visita escolar al Instituto de Alta Energía, un científico loco, el Dr. No, está realizando un experimento con una lente capaz de convertir materia en antimateria, lo que provoca un accidente y un rayo incontrolado que lanza a Chip y al científico a la dimensión del micromundo. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cómo regresar. Unos átomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrógeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarán para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el Dr. No descubre que, debido al accidente, ha logrado crear antimateria, y el poder que esto le otorga lo prepara para convertirse en el amo del mundo.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La corriente electrica
programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atómica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podría ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensión, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el científico perdió durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No está construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa máquina que lo ayudará a esclavizar a todos los átomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente eléctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: Three Quarter Moon
programme.desc: Hartmut, a taxi-driver, is left in a bitter slump when his wife leaves him. That is, until he gets six-year-old Hayat and her mother in his taxi. In a serendipitous turn of events, Hayat is left under his care and she helps him learn to enjoy life again.

programme.title: On The Fringe
programme.desc: The countdown of three characters – lawyer-activist Rafa, cashier Azucena and grandmother Teodora - with three interwoven stories who try to stay afloat and survive 24 key hours that may forever change the course of their lives.

programme.title: Vera Dreams of the Sea
programme.desc: Vera, a devoted wife, mother, and grandmother, has her serene life turned upside down by her husband's sudden suicide. As greedy relatives and an underworld scheme threaten their family’s home, she must confront danger and take control of her own fate.

programme.title: Helen Dorn: The Seeds Of Violence
programme.desc: At the Hamburg DOM festival, Helen Dorn and forensic scientist Weyer witness a paramedic's brutal assault. When a high-society boy is later found dead, unravelling a dark secret linking the two cases.

programme.title: Cloves & Carnations
programme.desc: In snowy and desolate South Eastern Anatolian, Musa carries the corpse of his deceased wife to their homeland with his granddaughter. As they get closer to a country at war, their run-in with the police separates them in different directions.

programme.title: Jeanny: The Fifth Girl

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Rainbow Badge

So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Transport Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee's old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. No worries, the Squirrels can run after him and give it back. They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, they're on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodri's front door.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mystery Seeds
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds it's time for some gardening!

programme.desc: Lemon performs a stand-up routine!

programme.desc: It's Merry Sprouty Day, but Evil Pea jumps onto Sprouty Claus's train and steals all the presents for herself!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S02 - Messy Migration

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Ludwig The Lady
programme.desc: Jackson's big, blue chicken-thing, Ludwig, is going to lay an egg. And it's up to Mojo and Bo to carry the big bird across dangerous roads to Preston's egg-hatching shed!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Good Choices
programme.desc: The Squirrels haven't been making good choices round the messy clubhouse. With Duggee's help, they start to get it right. But not before sending Roly's imagination into overdrive!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Waiting Badge
programme.desc: When they're accidentally shut in the shed, Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make the time pass with calm breathing and made-up games. The Squirrels cope so well. Does Duggee?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Frog Song
programme.desc: It's fun on the counting train until Naughty Monkey starts to drive! Ethel makes a shape, Frog drops beats with a ribbit song, and Enid turns into anime to chase after a mouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Hey Quacky!
programme.desc: Worm and Ladybird wonder what's going on at Squirrel Club. There's a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Gliding, Argentina
programme.desc: The Go Jet cadets are taking to the skies in Argentina in an attempt to pass their academy gliding test. As gliders do not have engines, Xuli is teaching two other pilot cadets how to glide using thermals to keep them up in the air. Not wanting to miss out on the aerial action, Grandmaster Glitch gatecrashes the flying lesson in his Grim Glider! Not only has his glider got an engine, but he also wants to make the lesson into a race. Not cool...

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Hide and Seek
programme.desc: It's time for a family game of hide and seek. Everyone hides, while Bluey counts to twenty, but will she be able to stay focused on the game and not get distracted by all her toys.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Road Trip
programme.desc: Mum helps Bluey and Bingo find ways to entertain themselves on a family road trip, while Dad tries to stay ahead of the grey nomad convoy or risk camping near the toilets.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Pavlova
programme.desc: Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Café in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Rain
programme.desc: When a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Dino Poop
programme.desc: Jen is studying the poop of different dinosaurs on the island, so Andy heads out on an epic adventure to collect some samples. Along the way, he meets an Alamosaurus.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Bubbles
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun blowing and popping bubbles. In the Cloud Kitchen, all the bubbles give Patch an idea for a tasty treat - blast off melon rockets!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Eating Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having a picnic and notice that the chickens eat differently than they do. Duggee has his eating badge and can explain all the different ways animals eat. Some animals eat slowly like cows, who eat all day long. But others eat quickly like frogs. Some, like goats, are always eating, while tortoises can go a whole year without food. programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Dream Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are at the Clubhouse playing, but they can't stop thinking about the dreams they had last night. Luckily, Duggee has his dream badge and can help the Squirrels work out what they mean. As the Squirrels think about dreams, all the different dreams of the Clubhouse friends become weirder and more wonderful. We even get to see Duggee's dream!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Rainbow Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are out walking around in the rain with Duggee and notice a rainbow! But before they know it, it's gone and the Squirrels are devastated. They decide to make their own rainbow and go off in search of all the colours from everything around them, including strawberries, carrots and bananas. Duggee shows the Squirrels what he has been working on too - a rainbow cake!

programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch wants to watch his favourite DVD in peace, so uses his remote control to pause the Rio Carnival in Brazil!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Aqueduct of Segovia
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch has turned the Segovia Aqueduct into a giant water slide, by removing some of it's ancient stones to make it slope. But taking some of the perfectly balanced stones away means that the tall columns of the aqueduct are wobbling, and could come crashing down! The Go Jetters don't have long to stop Glitch and re-build the historic structure - Go Jetters, Go!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Frog Song

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Nomads, Mongolia

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Camping
programme.desc: While on a camping holiday, Bluey makes a new friend named called Jean-Luc. Bluey may not understand him, but they find a common language playing and hunting for a wild Daddy pig.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Ice Cream
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want a lick of each other's ice cream. But they are so focused on making sure each lick is fair, they don't notice their ice creams are melting.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Rain
programme.desc: When a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Pizza Girls
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo make mud pizzas and deliver them to the grown-ups, but their pedal car's wheel keeps falling off.

programme.desc: When a pterosaur destroys Jen's dino proximity machine, Andy goes on an adventure to retrieve the pieces. Along the way, he meets velociraptors, an Alamosaurus and some hungry Gorgosaurus.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Hedgehog
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Sing Song Forest, where Tincy the Spider needs help from the Playtimers to wake up her furry friend, Hedge the Hedgehog.

As the Squirrels think about dreams, all the different dreams of the Clubhouse friends become weirder and more wonderful. We even get to see Duggee's dream!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Mount Everest, Asia
programme.desc: Kyan wants to climb Mount Everest, but his daring plan is interrupted by Grandmaster Glitch, who's careering down the mountain in a giant snowball.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch wants to watch his favourite DVD in peace, so uses his remote control to pause the Rio Carnival in Brazil!

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Emily's Best Friend
programme.desc: Emily worries that she doesn't have a best friend. Soon she realises she's been surrounded by best friends all along.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Bug Bop
programme.desc: Bug and his friends lead Sarah and Duck to their outdoor music concert.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Duck Flies

programme.desc: Stanley cleans Cynthia's bus, but each time he does it keeps getting dirty again. It's so dirty by the end, he invents a super-duper cleaning machine that makes a sea of bubbles.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - House
programme.desc: Myrtle's aunt Cressy is coming to stay, and she needs Stanley to make her a bed for her. This escalates into Stanley building her a whole set of rooms outside Myrtles actual house.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Actually Gave Santa a High Five
programme.desc: The talking animals talk about everything they love about Easter, Halloween, and Christmas!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S03 - It's Time to Look for Clues
programme.desc: Cynthia has found a teddy lying on the ground - can JoJo and Gran Gran find its owner? JoJo discovers three clues - space, blue wool and a special label. Will they help Detective JoJo and Detective Gran Gran track down the owner of the lost teddy? Could it be Isaiah? Or maybe Raya? They're off to the park café and the market to find out. Detective JoJo will need to think carefully about all the clues if she is going to solve the case of the missing teddy.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ghostbasket - Bluey special trilogy episode 1
programme.desc: Dad is pretending to be an estate agent selling the Grannies' house to Mum, but Janet and Rita do not want to move out. They try to disrupt the sale by ambushing Mum in the hallway, driving their car through the kitchen and introducing Ghostbasket - a ghastly haunted washing basket.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Surprise! - Bluey special trilogy episode 3
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want dad to play two different games, so dad tries to play both at the same time. While also watching the race on TV.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Bedroom
programme.desc: Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bed time comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Toast
programme.desc: The Teletubbies eat lots of Tubby Toast and make a huge pile of crumbs. Luckily, The Noo-­Noo is on hand to clean up.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: The Emperor orders Feng to find proofs of Master Tian's rebellion in his house. Feng falls in love with Tian's granddaughter and marries her. When he finds the proofs and tries to leave with her, his wife is killed in the fight against Tian. Feng creates the mantis-style martial arts and vows to avenge her death.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: In this surprisingly light-hearted "Venoms" martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Perils Of The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: During the Three Kingdoms period, a Taoist priest Yu Ji cures many patients with his supernatural powers and is loved by the people. However, the arrogant general Sun Che thinks that Yu Ji bewitches people and orders for him to be beheaded. Subsequently, the spirit of the Yu Ji rises from his dead body and takes revenge on Sun Che.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy “House of 72 tenants”, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Lady is the Boss
programme.desc: Mei, a young overseas Chinese woman, returns to Hong Kong to take over a traditional martial arts school. Her modern management style clashes with her conservative senior disciple, sparking disputes and attracting local gangsters. Forced to put aside their differences, they join forces to fight back and defend the school's honour.

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandits.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot...

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend “Investiture of the Gods”, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperor's Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army?

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry him-only for her to refuse his proposal.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrate's daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: Su Can, the carefree yet unruly eldest son of a winery owner, is forced to study under a tutor after being expelled from school. He soon discovers that his tutor is a martial arts master and becomes his disciple. However, when his family and master are slain by the ruthless bandit, Centipede, Su Can embarks on a perilous quest for revenge.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlong's younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles...

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named “The Fastest Sword” but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during China's early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Living Buddha Ji Gong and the immortal Lu Dong Bin descend to the mortal world, where the fates of several women spark a rivalry. As the two deities showcase their powers in three bizarre contests, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds. Amid romantic entanglements, an epic battle between immortals and mortals begins.

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards' heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi’s husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes…

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika’s mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn…

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang’s custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai…

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lian’s affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs II
programme.desc: In this prequel, the secrets of “Infernal Affairs” are revealed - the resentment between police superintendent Wong and crime boss Sam, as well as the beginning of the parallel fates of the two moles, Yan and Ming. The keys lie in the hands of Sam's wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian’s daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond…

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Sticky Business

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S2 - Punishment and Torcher

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Everest Returns

Yi’s music also calls on Everest, who returns to join the crew and find Fenghuang a suitable home.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Welcome Home, Everest!
programme.desc: While Yi and the crew try to pinpoint how Yi’s magic works, they notice that Everest isn’t looking too hot. In fact, he’s too hot. The crew tries everything to cool him down, even begging their old foe, Burnish, for help. Out of options, Yi tries to use her magic to send Everest home – until Burnish and his jerboa sidekick, Duchess, reveal that they’ve made over the kids’ rooftop fort into a high-tech HQ, complete with various tech gadgets for the crew and a temperature-controlled chamber for Ev

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Misconcepted Deceptions

In an effort to get her out of her funk and into studying again, the cousins invent a secret admirer for Sandra. They soon find Sandra's constant need for affirmation exhausting — a further complication in their attempt to keep up their group grade point average.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Reach For The Pod
programme.desc: When Sandra signs Pod 4 up for an academic quiz show, the kids are soon figuring out how to best leverage their TV exposure. It soon becomes obvious that four separate agenda do not add up to a cohesive team as they suffer near humiliation at the hands of the preppie team from Rydell High.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Big Man On Canvas
programme.desc: Raffi's win at the district art show hurtles Birch into the five stages of grief, her reactions throwing her podmates for a loop. Luckily, Liam's hip to what's going on thanks to a book Mr. Towes has assigned him. While Sandra trails Liam in hopes of seeing some emotional fireworks on Birch's part, Raffi can't quite get over the idea that Birch wouldn't be happy for his success.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - The Pencil Assassin
programme.desc: Birch is initially aghast when Jason publishes her Manga “sample” in the school paper, but soon succumbs to the allure of popularity. As Birch's social status soars, her podmates become laughingstocks. Sandra's retaliation eventually brings the two girls together in their fight against the unethical editor of The Cosmos Chronicle.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Plays The Piano

But when her little brother Ian begins taking his own piano lessons – and turns out to be pretty good – Olivia isn't sure if there's room for two prodigies in the family.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Plays Football
programme.desc: Francine is chosen to play goalie, and Olivia is disappointed that she doesn't get to wear the red goalie jersey. Even worse, the uniform she designs for herself only causes chaos and confusion among her teammates. But when Francine is better at dodging the ball than stopping it, it's up to Olivia to put on the red goalie jersey and save the day

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Cleat without Feet Real Magic

When Dylan starts practicing magic tricks, Athena thinks his magic is real! But when the Dew Drops investigate his “magic hat,” they accidentally break it and must fix it before Dylan’s magic show for the neighborhood kids.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - You (Don't) Snooze, You Lose Save The Squasher

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Gopher it! A Glamping We Will Go
programme.desc: When a pesky gopher gets in the way of Fawna making her famous veggie stew, Niah learns to not let a bad experience, get in the way of doing good. When the inexperienced Rona has to step in for Donna, the team makes sure everyone has the best camping trip ever.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Bully For You The Ra Animator

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Weekend At Bunny's Grimly Day
programme.desc: Weekend at Bunny's Alder and Dash sound the alarm after a terrifying creature threatens Scare School. Grimly Day It's Grimly Day?the grimmest day of the year!

To get back to their normal size, they need to find the right ingredients to make a grow potion, which means going on an itty-bitty search through the dollhouse! For our Cat of the Day segment, Mercat shows us how to make sparkly, mermaid slime.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - It's Purrsday!
programme.desc: It's Purrsday, the happiest cat day of the year, and all the Gabby Cats have a special purrsday surprise. Gabby and Pandy make peekaboo kitty paper chains with Baby Box, decorate a Purrsday cake with Cakey, Gabby gets a special kitty makeover with Mercat, and everyone sings a Purrsday song with DJ Catnip. For the COTD, DJ Catnip shows us how to make a DJ Catnip purr-stick!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Banana Bread Burglar Finding Meow Meow
programme.desc: When the banana bread Harper leaves out for Eden is stolen, the Dew Drops create a sting operation to catch the thief.
